# Tight, consistent trusted observations around an arbitrary integer matrix.
y=json.loads(json.dumps(x));y['id']='tight';y['domains']=[];y['max_faults']=0
from fractions import Fraction
for si,s in enumerate(y['snapshots']):
 q=[r.randint(0,100) for _ in commodities]
 s['bounds']=[[0,100] for _ in commodities];s['controller']=[50]*12;s['tolerance']=2
 met={};loads={e['id']:Fraction(0) for e in edges}
 for c,v in zip(commodities,q):
  met['demand',c['id']]=v;W=sum(z['weight'] for z in c['routes'])
  for route in c['routes']:
   for ei in route['edges']:loads[ei]+=Fraction(v*route['weight'],W)
 for n in nodes:
  met['ingress',n]=sum(v for c,v in zip(commodities,q) if c['source']==n)
  met['egress',n]=sum(v for c,v in zip(commodities,q) if c['target']==n)
 met.update({('link',e):v for e,v in loads.items()})
 for o in s['observations']:
  o['domain']=None;v=met[o['metric'],o['target']]
  # Integral closed bounds containing the exact value.
  o['lower']=int(v)-r.randint(0,1);o['upper']=int(v)+r.randint(0,1)
  if v.denominator!=1:o['upper']=int(v)+1
open('/workspace/submission/stress_tight.json','w').write(json.dumps(y))
t=time.time();p=subprocess.run(['/workspace/submission/run.sh'],input=json.dumps(y)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=170)
print('tight return',p.returncode,'wall',time.time()-t,'out',len(p.stdout),'err',p.stderr[:1000])
if p.returncode==0:
 a=json.loads(p.stdout);print(a['status'],a['min_faults'],a['snapshots'][0]['demands'][:2])
